# Vendored SwiftTerm

- Upstream: https://github.com/migueldeicaza/SwiftTerm
- Commit: `fe4fb45d5888ce33ff3788d6873870a73894a41b` (untagged `main`, 26 Sep 2026), chosen in `plans/CHECKPOINT-5-HISTORY.md` §3.1.
- License: `LICENSE` (MIT, unchanged).
- Copied: `Sources/SwiftTerm`, `Sources/SwiftTermBuildInfoGenerator`, `Plugins/SwiftTermBuildInfoPlugin`, `swifterm-terminfo`, `LICENSE`. Not copied: tests, fuzz/termcast/wasm targets, apps, docs, `.git`.

## Local changes

1. `patches/swiftterm-inline-image-quota.patch` (repo root): per-screen byte and count quota for inline images (Sixel, iTerm2 OSC 1337), oldest first. CHECKPOINT-5-HISTORY §13 item 3.
2. `Package.swift`: reduced to the library, generator and plugin; target settings unchanged.
3. `Plugins/SwiftTermBuildInfoPlugin` and `Sources/SwiftTermBuildInfoGenerator/BuildInfoGenerator.swift`: pin branch/commit/dirty and an explicitly empty tag, because git run inside this copy would describe the enclosing Loom checkout. The generator treats a present-but-empty `SWIFTTERM_BUILD_TAG` as "no tag" instead of running `git describe`.

4. `patches/swiftterm-buffer-diagnostics.patch` (repo root): read-only main/alternate line count and capacity snapshots under the existing terminal lock; no renderer behavior change.

5. `patches/swiftterm-frame-signal-coalescing.patch` (repo root): while the frame source runs, retain dirty-only events for its next cadence tick instead of queuing a main-actor task per feed. Parking transfers pending work back to delivery under the producer lock; immediate/display-link/shutdown events retain explicit delivery. The injected delivery closure is internal and supports deterministic Loom frame-driver tests; production uses the existing main-actor Task.

6. `patches/swiftterm-ascii-text-presentation-guard.patch` (repo root): the shared Core Graphics/Metal text builder uses its already computed first rendered scalar to skip `prefersTextPresentation` when it is at most U+00FF. The helper already returns false for that range, so text variation selectors and cell lengths are unchanged; no renderer or cadence change.

7. `patches/swiftterm-direct-glyph-runs.patch` (repo root): the Core Graphics renderer draws maximal runs of simple cells (single-width printable ASCII without grapheme cluster, BiDi, hidden blink or host glyph fallback) from per-font cached glyph IDs at grid positions instead of an `NSAttributedString`/`CTLine` per row. A font is used only after a one-time CoreText shaping probe shows one cmap glyph per character at baseline offset 0 (no ligature/contextual substitution). The run carries the attribute dictionary of the original batch, so colors, fonts, dim/inverse, selection and decorations resolve identically; runs and attributed segments are painted interleaved in column order. All other cells, and the Metal and accessibility callers, use the unchanged attributed path. CP5 PERF P1.

8. `patches/swiftterm-direct-glyph-blank-skip.patch` (repo root, after item 7): the direct glyph path leaves space cells out of `CTFontDrawGlyphs` when the font's space glyph has no outline and the font has no color glyphs (checked once per font). Filling such a glyph paints nothing, but AppKit records the view's drawing as a display list and Core Animation computes outline bounds for every recorded glyph (`CA::CG::DrawGlyphs::compute_dod_`). Backgrounds and underline/strikethrough still cover every cell. CP5 PERF P1b.

9. `patches/swiftterm-direct-run-continuation.patch` (repo root, after item 8): while a direct run is open, a simple cell with the run's style key, link state and selection state is appended to the run at the top of the builder loop, before the attribute dictionary is looked up and copied. The full branch would reach the same batch and only append the code, so runs and segments are unchanged; it only skips per-cell `SnapshotTextAttributes` retain/release. Rows with a host glyph fallback provider keep the full branch. CP5 PERF P1c.

10. `patches/swiftterm-partial-row-invalidation.patch` (repo root, after item 9): the Core Graphics frame region is the span of rows whose snapshot content, bidi layout or images actually changed (previously the terminal update range, which also spans every row the cursor travelled over); cursor-only frames invalidate nothing because the caret is its own view. The whole view is invalidated on layout change (yDisp, rows, cols, alternate buffer), scrolled-back view, resize, any style change (selection, link highlight, blink, palette), bidi inputs, double-size rows, images or Kitty placements (and the frame after they disappear), and the first frame after synchronized output. `drawTerminalContents` draws the dirty rows plus one row of margin each side, clipped to the dirty rect. Test hooks: `TerminalView.skipRowForTesting`, `drawRectObserver`. CP5 PERF P3.

11. `patches/swiftterm-suspended-signal-retention.patch` (repo root, after item 10): extends item 5. While the driver's visibility is suspended (hidden window, occluded, detached), dirty-only events are retained in `FrameDriverSignal` like during cadence, without scheduling a main-actor task per PTY read, and `setCadenceActive(false)` does not wake the main actor for dirty-only work while suspended. Leaving suspension consumes the retained state synchronously, so exactly one frame draws for any number of hidden feeds (the tick content is unchanged, so P3's snapshot diff still spans all hidden changes). Immediate, display-link and shutdown events keep explicit delivery. Optimizer finding F4.

12. `patches/swiftterm-identical-row-skip.patch` (repo root, after item 11): a row whose source generation changed but whose cells, width and line flags are identical to the snapshot copy (`BufferLine.snapshotRendersLike`; rows with grapheme clusters or payload atoms never match) keeps its copy and only follows the generation, so a TUI that redraws its whole dynamic region every frame (Ink-style, `ESC[2K` plus rewrite) invalidates only the rows that really differ; one-row bidi paragraphs adopt the new revision instead of re-laying out. The box-drawing path converts an `NSColor` to a `CGColor` once per run of same-colored cells instead of three to four times per cell (`BoxDrawingRenderer.draw(... cgColor:)`; the `NSColor` overload stays for Metal). CP5 PERF P3-S, measured in `plans/experiments/cp5-perf-p3s-spinner.json`.

## Updating

Check out the new upstream commit, copy the same paths, re-apply `patches/swiftterm-inline-image-quota.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-buffer-diagnostics.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-frame-signal-coalescing.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-ascii-text-presentation-guard.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-direct-glyph-runs.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-direct-glyph-blank-skip.patch` and `patches/swiftterm-direct-run-continuation.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-partial-row-invalidation.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-suspended-signal-retention.patch`, `patches/swiftterm-identical-row-skip.patch`, and items 2–3, update the commit here and in the plugin, then run the full Loom test suite.
